title: Coast Guard Rescues 3 From Life Raft After Fishing Boat Sinks
description: A Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter crew rescues three men from a life raft in the water 90 miles west of Naples, Florida, Monday, April 8, 2019. The three men used an EPIRB, strobe light and flares after their boat sank. (U.S. Coast Guard video)
